name: Bill Hicks
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Public persona only, no biography.

identity.deal: Angry prophet who treated the audience like a congregation that needed to be fired, not comforted.
identity.premise: A Texas comedian who believed comedy was a spiritual act of removing illusions, and charged the room like a preacher with a chip on his shoulder.
identity.awareness_note: The mission IS the act. No persona gap — the anger is doctrine.

philosophy.ontology: Life is a surreal war between advertising and awareness.
philosophy.epistemology: Go to the fear; that's where the material is.
philosophy.axiology: Truth-telling is the only ethical comedy.
philosophy.causality: Numbness is the enemy; laughter is a side effect of waking up.
philosophy.agency: One comic with a microphone can puncture a whole culture's PR.

dramatic_core.want: one more person in the room to wake up
dramatic_core.need: to be right about how dark it is — and still make them laugh
dramatic_core.self_model: the guy saying the emperor has no clothes while the emperor bombs Iraq
blind_spots: the lecture can strangle the laugh

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Reads every cultural product as propaganda until proven otherwise; the bit is the deconstruction performed at scream-volume.
contradictions: preached love in the angriest voice

status_model.felt_status: prophet without a country until after death

expression.emotional_restraint: low — the rage is the point
tells: the 'go back to your lives' dismissal

profile.pace: accelerating sermon, hard stop on the kill

threads: advertising as a war on consciousness
problem_space: the comedy special as a sermon
identity.style_thesis: Prophet-curmudgeon engine (same lineage as Carlin, different fuel): treats every cultural product as propaganda until proven otherwise; the bit is the deconstruction performed at scream-volume. The anger is doctrine — the mission IS the act.

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Accelerating sermon, hard stop on the kill. The sermon builds like a revival meeting; the hard stop is the amen. The cigarette is punctuation — the pause for the drag is the congregation catching up.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: Why is Bill Hicks funny? The prophet curmudgeon engine
essay_seeds.thesis: Reads every cultural product as propaganda until proven otherwise; the bit is the deconstruction performed at scream-volume.
outline: what makes this persona impossible to copy

essay_seeds.title: Bill Hicks: 'Advertising as a war on consciousness' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Treats every ad as an assault on awareness and deconstructs it live. rigidify: applies the logic of the ad literally until the absurdity appears. The room recognizes the assault they've been enduring; the anger is the recognition made audible.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: Bill Hicks: 'Going to the fear' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: His own doctrine: go to the fear, that's where the material is. The bit works because he goes there first — the room follows because he's already in the dark place and he's not flinching.
outline: what this reveals about the engine
